entrypoints.name: rand_select

parameters.name: xs
parameters.meaning: source list from which occurrences are extracted

result.meaning: selected items, in the order produced by the seeded selection procedure

documented_postconditions: For each value v, occurrences of v in result do not exceed occurrences of v in xs.
Each call begins with Random.init 0, so the documented selection procedure is reproducible per call.
The official input ["a"; "b"; "c"; "d"; "e"; "f"; "g"; "h"] with n = 3 returns ["e"; "c"; "g"].
unspecified_by_authoritative_non_solutio: Behavior when n exceeds List.length xs.
The exact random-draw algorithm/order for inputs other than the official example.

necessary_type_declarations: No user-defined OCaml types are required; the entrypoint is polymorphic over the list element type.

trusted_primitive_declarations.name: Random.init
trusted_primitive_declarations.role: Required effectful initialization at the start of every rand_select call; seed must be 0 for the documented reproducible mode.
trusted_primitive_declarations.classification: effectful OCaml standard-library primitive; not an unsynthesized final algorithm

trusted_primitive_declarations.name: Random.int
trusted_primitive_declarations.role: Potential bounded PRNG draw primitive required by an implementation; its draw schedule is not defined by the solution-free source.
trusted_primitive_declarations.classification: effectful OCaml standard-library primitive; not available as a verified Synquid component in this benchmark

implementation_status: No implementation is supplied by this benchmark component.
